name: coverLetter
value:
Hi Niyyt team,

I build products from the interface to the backend, and your Next.js/Node.js role fits the work I do. I have four years of TypeScript and Next.js experience, production PostgreSQL experience, and hands-on Node.js, REST API and MongoDB work. My projects include AI analytics, AI writing software, and connected web and mobile education products.

I am a Pakistani citizen based in Pakistan and can work Australian business hours. I am currently employed, with my contract ending at the end of October.

Portfolio: https://itsubaidullahomer.com
GitHub: https://github.com/itsubaidullahomer

I would welcome a technical discussion about what you are building.

Ubaidullah Omer
